text.title: FreshDrop order domain: orders, slots, payments and couriers
text.a1: order id, created at, slot, total in RUB, status
text.a2: phone, name, district, address, card token
text.a3: date, 2-hour window, capacity, fee in RUB
text.a4: amount, method (card, SBP), status, paid at
text.a5: code, discount %, valid until, minimum basket
text.a7: SKU, name, unit price, stock, category
text.rules: A buyer makes many orders; an order has one slot, one courier, one payment and one promo code. Payments are kept apart to allow retries.
